uomo.aspetto: a grotesque man in his fifties who has changed into something much too tall and thin: a long, stretched, expressionless grey face, small black eyes, the mouth a long open black oval, a neck stretched long and thin, arms so long that the hands hang below the knees, long grey fingers; in a navy striped tracksuit split open at the seams

parti.occhi: Small, completely black eyes, without whites, sunk deep in a long, stretched, expressionless grey face; the skin around them pulled tight and thin.
parti.bocca: The mouth is a long open black oval, stretched far too long, without teeth, the lips thin and grey; hot breath fogs the air in front of it.
parti.collo: A neck stretched far too long and thin, grey, with the vertebrae showing under the skin like a string of knots; the zipper of the tracksuit split open around it.

mani.inquadratura: one of his hands hanging below his knee, against the split tracksuit trousers
mani.segni: A long grey hand with fingers far too long and thin, each with one joint too many; the nails broken and white with plaster dust, as if they had scratched the ceiling.

giovane.aspetto: a grotesque but almost photographic pale, very thin young woman of about twenty, with long dark hair, in a grey cardigan

parti.occhi_grave: Her eyes are sunken and glassy with very high fever, the whites red, deep dark circles under them; the skin grey and shiny with sweat, damp hair stuck to the forehead.
parti.collo_grave: Under the jaw, a large, hard, dark purple swelling the size of an egg, tight and shiny, with a darker spot in the middle: a plague bubo; the skin around it hot and shiny with sweat.
parti.mani_grave: Her thin hands tremble; the tips of two fingers are turning black, as if burnt.

nonna.aspetto: a grotesque but almost photographic very old woman with white hair and cloudy eyes, in a dark flowered dressing gown

parti.occhi_grave: Her old eyes, clouded by cataracts, are glassy with very high fever, the lids red and swollen; the wrinkled skin grey and shiny with sweat.
parti.collo_grave: Under the jaw, a large, hard, dark purple swelling the size of an egg, tight and shiny, with a darker spot in the middle: a plague bubo; the skin around it hot and shiny with sweat.
parti.mani_grave: Her old knotted hands tremble; the tips of three fingers are turning black, as if burnt.
